phase: 18.2 — eliminate the source -> authority -> source round trip in the direct build
claim: field-build with --profile runtime now scans the ORIGINAL input bytes for DocumentField structure while separately storing the exact RAW authority, verifying (length + byte compare, hence SHA-256) that the authority materializes to that source; materialize(descriptor) == source is unimpaired and the field answers every observation identically.

where_the_redundant_pass_was: src/field/build.rs: direct_ingest() -> ingest_with() re-materialized the source from the authority just to detect ZIP vs PDF, then dispatched
src/field/ingest.rs: ingest_pdf_with() called FieldStore::ingest (which materializes) AND field.materialize_exact() (a second materialization) only to hand the bytes to scan()
src/field/ingest_package.rs: ingest_package_with() called materialize() on the parsed observable purely to obtain the bytes to scan
what_changed: added FieldStore::ingest_verified(descriptor, source, limits): parse + materialize + byte-compare to the caller's source (the single remaining round trip, now a verification rather than a discard); FieldStore::ingest delegates to a shared ingest_parsed tail

split ingest_pdf_with into ingest_pdf_with (materializing, unchanged) and ingest_pdf_stage_b(source, manifest); added pub(crate) ingest_pdf_direct(observable, source) that verifies against the caller's source and scans it
split ingest_package_with into ingest_package_with (materializing, unchanged) and ingest_package_from_source(source, parsed); added pub(crate) ingest_package_direct(observable, source)
build_field_with now passes the original source and the already-enriched authority straight to the direct variants; encode + field-ingest (the non-direct CLI path) are byte-for-byte unchanged

ab_measurement.lane: doc-baseline release, single run per step (no repetition)

current_lane_unchanged_control.note: encode + field-ingest is untouched; the two runs agree within ~0.8% single-run noise, so the A/B is fair

direct_build.honest_reading: Wall time improves modestly; the extra source-sized materializations were cheap (a RAW literal-object decode is essentially a memcpy), so removing two of three passes saves only ~6% wall. The real, consistent win is peak RSS: the removed full-size source buffers no longer coexist, cutting peak RSS by ~20-32% on the large documents and ~29% at the median.

observations_phase17.note: identical counts before and after; the schedule results (raw/observe.tsv) are byte-identical between the two direct runs

authority_bytes.note: the stored authority is unchanged by the refactor (same blob, same SHA-256)

contract_court.delta: -1.8% VOLE build wall; gap essentially unchanged
contract_court.honest_reading: The contract-court build gap does not move (7.24x -> 7.21x). The round trip was NOT the bottleneck there: the build wall is dominated by the descriptor encode (RAW literal object) and the with_observation_index parse+reserialize, not by the materialize passes. This is reported as measured, not as a win.

discarded_run.why: host contention (4 unrelated 43-47h containers, loadavg ~3.7/16); every single-process build wall was inflated (e.g. docx-0005 47 ms -> 858 ms) while the same binary measured ~4 MB / <10 ms afterwards. Re-run TAG=onepass2 on the same binary/commit returned to 11689 ms.

files.raw/phase17-before: 9-doc direct court, pre-change (build.tsv, exact.tsv, observe.tsv, subset.tsv, summary.txt)
files.raw/phase18-contract: 12-doc C0..C5 contract court, post-change (onetime.tsv=VOLE build, build.tsv=SQLite build, summary.txt, SUMMARY.md)

residual_risks: The refactor adds FieldStore::ingest_verified, whose byte-compare is the ONLY whole-source check on the direct path (encode_with's court already proved materialize(descriptor)==source, so this is a redundant-in-depth guard, not the sole proof).
Wall-time results are single-run; the ~6% direct-build gain is within the range of run-to-run noise on the small documents. The RSS reduction is the robust signal.

The direct path re-derives the ZIP-vs-PDF family with document_format::is_zip(source), then the package adapter scans the same source again: two ZIP scans, exactly as the previous ingest_with+ingest_package_with pair did (no regression, but not consolidated).
The contract-court build gap remains ~7.2x; this phase does not close it. The dominant build cost (descriptor encode + observation-index reserialization) is untouched and would be the next target.
